description:
Create a batch calling campaign

Creates an outbound campaign: a named list of up to 10000 numbers that one voice agent will call. The campaign is created in state `draft` and nothing is dialled until you submit it, so this call places no calls and incurs no call charges. The agent must belong to you, and so must `callerPhoneNumberId` if you set one; either being unknown or owned by someone else gives 404. Per-recipient `metadata` is handed to the agent as conversation context, which is how you personalise each call. This operation is guarded by the `write:agents` scope rather than a scope of its own.

body.description: The campaign name, the identifier of the voice agent that will place the calls (`agent_42`, as returned by GET /agents), and the recipient list. Optionally `scheduledTime`, an ISO 8601 timestamp for when calls should begin, and `callerPhoneNumberId`, the database id of the number to call from; without it the system default number is used.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent to call with, as returned by GET /agents (agent_42)

callerPhoneNumberId.description: Database ID of the phone number to call from. If omitted, system default is used.

metadata.description: Custom key-value data passed to the agent as context

scheduledTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. If omitted, calls start immediately upon submission.

name: create_call_campaign
title: Create a batch calling campaign
